name: Marvel Discovery Corp.
summary: Marvel Discovery Corp. is a Canadian enterprise dedicated to the acquisition, exploration, and advancement of mineral properties across the nation. The company possesses an exclusive option to secure full ownership of the Duhamel Property, which consists of nine mineral claims spread over approximately 500 hectares northwest of Saguenay, Quebec. Its diverse Canadian portfolio also encompasses the Wicheeda North project in British Columbia, comprising 18 claims spanning 4,423.8 hectares northeast of Prince George, and the Blackfly property, situated near Atikokan, Ontario, comprising five claims that collectively encompass 64 unpatented mining claims. Furthermore, Marvel Discovery Corp. holds options to acquire a 100% interest in several other notable assets. These include the Slip Gold property in Newfoundland, made up of six claims totaling 264 claim units; the Victoria/Long Lake property, also in Newfoundland, which consists of five claims with 53 claim units; and the East Bull property in Ontario's Deagle, Gaiashk, and Gerow mining district, featuring 16 mineral claims. Additional options cover the Sandy Pond and Baie Verte Line property in Newfoundland and Labrador, covering 335 mineral claims. Beyond these options, the company holds an interest in the Gander South project, a 14-mineral-claim area located in Newfoundland. Moreover, the firm maintains an option to obtain complete control of the Highway North property, situated in Saskatchewan's Athabasca region, an area composed of five contiguous claims amounting to 2,573 hectares. Formerly known as International Montoro Resources Inc., the company officially adopted the name Marvel Discovery Corp. in February 2021. Established in 1987, Marvel Discovery Corp. maintains its corporate headquarters in Vancouver, Canada.
